court: In the High Court of Madras
judges_raw: (Before S.M. Subramaniam and K. Surender, JJ.)
advocates: Mr.A.Selvendran Special Government Pleader, for the Contemnor(s):
judgment_text:
ORDER

S.M. Subramaniam, J.:— contempt petition has been instituted against the interim order passed in W.A. No. 1360 of 2024, dated 26-6-2025.

2. The learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Special Government Pleader would submit that batch of writ appeals have already been heard by the Division Bench of this Court and orders were reserved. Thus, the present contempt petition becomes unnecessary.

3. Recording the submissions, the contempt petition is closed. No costs.
